investigation.title: Remote Agent Creation Eval Failing: POST /api/agents Returns 409 Agent Quota Exceeded (limit is 100)
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-06-16T15:21:42–45Z with an identical 409 conflict response from POST /api/agents: "conflict: agent quota exceeded: limit is 100". The eval probe's createAgent call was rejected before any agent was provisioned, so zero required evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was collected and all contract assertions went unmet.
investigation.rootCause: The production-api swarm backend rejected the eval's POST /api/agents request with HTTP 409 and error code "conflict: agent quota exceeded: limit is 100". Because agent creation was blocked at the API boundary, the runner branch in infra/evals/status/run-status-probes.mjs (line 1339, createAgent call) never received a successful response, no evidence was written, and the expected-output contract for remote-agent-create (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) could not be satisfied. This is an eval-infrastructure failure caused by a quota exhaustion condition on the production swarm org used by the observability probe account; there is no evidence of a user-traffic or product outage in the supplied packet.

investigation.summary: All three remote-agents observability checks (remote-agent-state, remote-agent-create, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-06-16T15:21:43–45Z with the identical 409 conflict response: "conflict: agent quota exceeded: limit is 100". The eval runner calls POST /api/agents as its first step to provision a new remote agent, and the swarm backend is rejecting every such request because the org-scoped agent quota of 100 has been reached, preventing any evidence (orgId, agentId, readyState, state) from being collected.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm backend returned HTTP 409 with error code "conflict" and message "agent quota exceeded: limit is 100" for every POST /api/agents call made by the eval runner.
